Build Gene Set Scoring Benchmark Controls

Source: R/04j-BenchGeneScoreConfig.R
BenchGeneScoreConfigSet.Rd

Collects the arguments of a gene set scoring benchmark into the bench_config list of BenchGeneScoreConfig(). method selects the scoring backend, and additional named arguments are forwarded to that backend when BenchGeneScore() computes the scores.

Usage

BenchGeneScoreConfigSet(
  method = c("ssGSEA", "AUCell", "UCell", "AddModuleScore"),
  ...
)

Arguments

method

Character. Scoring backend to benchmark, one of "ssGSEA", "AUCell", "UCell", "AddModuleScore"; The package backing the selected backend is checked with rlang::check_installed(). Default: "ssGSEA".

...

Additional named arguments forwarded to the selected scoring backend. They are matched against the backend's formal arguments and, when a method needs two calls, split over its stages (e.g. GSVA::ssgseaParam() and GSVA::gsva() for "ssGSEA"). Case variants of the function's own arguments are resolved to their canonical names.

Value

A named list holding method and the extra backend arguments, to be used as the bench_config of BenchGeneScoreConfig().

See also

BenchGeneScoreConfig(), BenchGeneScore()

Other ConfigSet: BenchGSEAConfigSet(), BenchMemoryConfigSet(), MethodParamSet()

Examples

BenchGeneScoreConfigSet(method = "ssGSEA")
#> $method
#> [1] "ssGSEA"
#>
